scope: Permits a separately authorized paid Gemini 3.6 Flash pilot instead of the protocol's zero-cost requirement. This preregistration authorizes no live execution. Prompts, request bytes, generation configuration, schedules, outcomes and statistical procedures remain unchanged.
budget_policy: Before each request, reserve the full output ceiling plus a conservative input allowance. Stop if the reserve exceeds the remaining budget; stop if successful-response billing usage is unavailable. Estimates exclude taxes. Budget exhaustion may prevent completion of all 40 requests.
